content.title: How to watch Iowa women’s basketball vs. Illinois in Big Ten Tournament
content.text: Updated March 6, 2026, 4:33 p.m. CTLooking to start postseason play with something positive, No. 2 seed Iowa women's basketball faces No. 10 seed Illinois today in the Big Ten Tournament quarterfinals inside Indianapolis' Gainbridge Fieldhouse.The Hawkeyes (24-5) just faced the Fighting Illini (21-10) in what was a tense affair at Carver-Hawkeye Arena. Iowa's 82-78 win on Feb. 26 featured 14 lead changes and required the Hawkeyes to erase a six-point fourth-quarter deficit. Despite Illinois shooting 11-for-19 from deep, 28 points from Ava Heiden and 18 from Hannah Stuelke carried Iowa home.Illinois will be playing its third game in three days after beating No. 15 seed Wisconsin in the opening round and No. 7 seed Michigan State in the second round on Thursday.Here’s how to watch today's 5:30 p.m. CT game.Watch Iowa women's basketball vs. Illinois on Fubo (free trial)What channel is Iowa women's basketball vs. Illinois on today?TV: BTNStream: Fubo (free trial) and FoxSports.com (login required)Can't watch the game? We'll have live updates at this link.Iowa vs. Illinois time todayDate: Friday, March 6Start time: 5:30 p.m. CTLocation: Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, IndianaLive updates: Iowa women vs. IllinoisIowa women's basketball vs. Illinois predictionExpect another game just like the first one. A seesawing affair that comes down to the end, Iowa does a better job on perimeter defense and advances to the semifinals Saturday. Iowa 75, Illinois 71.Dargan Southard is a sports trending reporter and covers Iowa athletics for the Des Moines Register and HawkCentral.com.
